subtitle: The pipeline should tell you when something's wrong

caption: Zero custom code — Airflow sends the email automatically on any task failure.

code:
def alert_on_failure(context):
    task_id = context["task_instance"].task_id
    log_url = context["task_instance"].log_url
    send_slack_notification(text=f"{task_id} failed — {log_url}")
caption: Specific and actionable — one click to the actual failure log.

eyebrow: Set it once, apply it everywhere
caption: Configured once at the DAG level — not repeated on every task.
